metadata.case_title: ATIQA MUZAMMIL vs MUHAMMAD UMAR FAROOQ
statutes_cited: West Pakistan Family Courts Act (XXXV of 1964)

full_text:
2010 Y L R 1519

[Lahore]

Before Mian Saqib Nisar, J

ATIQA MUZAMMIL---Applicant

Versus

MUHAMMAD UMAR FAROOQ---Respondent

Transfer Application No. 351-C of 2008, decided on 4th November, 2008.

West Pakistan Family Courts Act (XXXV of 1964)---

----S.5, Sched. & S.25-A---Transfer of case---Application for---Spouses were separated and applicant who was living with her parents at place had filed suit for the dissolution of marriage before the Family Court at place while the respondent as a counterblast, had instituted a suit for the restitution of conjugal rights before the Family Court at place `K'---Suit filed by the respondent/ husband before the Family Court at place could not proceed on account of the lack of territorial jurisdiction and should be transferred to the Family Court at place where suit filed by the applicant/wife was pending adjudication---Suit of the respondent was withdrawn from the Family Court at place `K' and was entrusted to the Family Court at place where the suit of the applicant was pending.

Muhammad Tauqir Nasir for Petitioner.

Memo for Respondent.

ORDER

MIAN SAQIB NISAR, J.---Despite service, none appears for the respondent. It is stated that the petitioner was married to the respondent, but the spouses are separated. The petitioner is living with her parents at Lahore and has filed a suit for the dissolution of marriage before the Family Court at Lahore, while the respondent, as a counterblast, has instituted a suit for the restitution of conjugal rights before the Family Court at Kasur, which should be transferred to Lahore.

2. After hearing the learned counsel for the petitioner, I find that under the law, the suit of the respondent before the Family Court, Kasur cannot proceed on account of the lack of territorial jurisdiction and should be transferred to the Family Court, Lahore. Resultantly, the suit of the respondent is withdrawn from the Family Court, Kasur and is entrusted to the Court of Mr. Mansoor Atta, Judge Family Court, Lahore, where the suit of the petitioner is pending. Disposed of.

H.B.T./A-56/L Case transferred.
